title: BusinessAiSettings
description: Business-level AI settings, controlling which AI features a business allows. Evaluated independently of the packaging flags that make a feature available in the first place

uid.description: The unique identifier of the settings record. Null while the business is still on the defaults and no record has been written for it yet (e.g., "bas_9f31c2", null)

business_uid.description: The unique identifier of the business these settings belong to (e.g., "biz_abc123")

settings.description: Every known AI setting key, with its default filled in for keys the business has never changed. Defaults differ per key

note_summary.description: AI note summaries. While not allowed, no new note gets a summary and existing summaries are withheld from note responses. Speech-to-text on notes is unaffected

allow.description: Whether AI note summaries are allowed for this business. Defaults to true (e.g., true, false)

opted_in.description: Whether the business has opted in to AI. A business with no stored record is treated as not opted in until it explicitly opts in

allow.description: Whether the business has opted in to AI. Defaults to false (e.g., false, true)
